test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'hazardous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Hazardous** means involving or exposing one to risk (as of loss or harm).

** • Example-** ***Hazardous** waste must be properly disposed of.*

 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'hazardous'.**

**The complete sentence** is- *It has a hazardous__ effect on human health.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Safe** means not likely to cause danger, harm or risk.
 
• **Risky** means involving the possibility that something bad might happen or that something will fail or lose money.
 
• **Threatened** means to seem likely to do something unpleasant.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**
